title: The Core of API Testing: Response Validation

scenes.line1: What’s the one thing you must check
scenes.say: If you could only test one thing in a REST API, what would it be?

scenes.label: Status
scenes.sub: Check if the API returns the right status code for each operation.
scenes.say: First, always check if the API gives you the right status code for what you asked.

rows.b: Does the response match the expected shape?
Are content type and auth info correct?

scenes.say: Next, check the response shape, headers, and how errors are handled. These tell you if the API is reliable.

scenes.title: Postman Test Example
scenes.say: Tools like Postman let you automate checks for status and schema, so you can catch issues fast.

scenes.question: Should you only check for 200 OK?
scenes.right: No, you must check all relevant codes—like 201, 400, 401, and 500—to cover every scenario.
scenes.say: Don’t just look for a two hundred code. Real tests check for all possible responses, including errors.
